answer: Weight grows with squared unbroken tenure: each identity locks 200 units in one island vault, credited one tenure notch per verified epoch. All movement crosses its single bridge, whose toll log is public, and the reef wrecks and logs any landing attempted elsewhere. Keepers match notch counts against the toll log; a stake with an unmatched crossing loses its tenure. A farm gains nothing by splitting: 1,000 identities need 200,000 locked on 1,000 islands, while a 200-unit pool split 1,000 ways leaves each share's squared weight near zero. The honest 200 returns after 30 clean epochs.
